children: Global Asset Management Group agreed to acquire G & O Landscaping for a stated $1.82 million, paid via 840,000 restricted common shares and a $980,000 secured convertible note, with no cash at closing. The note bears 6% interest, matures in 2029, and is convertible at 85% of the 30-day VWAP without a floor or cap. To secure the note, the company pledged 100% of G&O shares, subject to senior-lender rights. Management expects the transaction to expand operations and support growth in landscaping services.
